# Joins and Pivots

## Joins
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
tbl1 <- tibble(
  name = c("Harry", "Hermione", "Ron"),
  gpa = c(3.8, 4.0, 3.0),
  coffee = c("yes", "no", "yes")
)
tbl1

tbl2 <- tibble(
  name = c("Harry", "Bellatrix", "Hermione", "Draco"),
  spells = c(60, 75, 70, 55),
  lunch = c("pizza", "tacos", "burrito", "pad thai")
)
tbl2
```

```{r}
left_join(tbl1, tbl2, by = "name")
right_join(tbl1, tbl2, by = "name")
full_join(tbl1, tbl2, by = "name")
inner_join(tbl1, tbl2, by = "name")
semi_join(tbl1, tbl2, by = "name")
anti_join(tbl1, tbl2, by = "name")
```

Question: What if the ID columns in x and y have different names?\
`semi_join(x, y, by = join_by(id1 == id2))`

## Pivots
```{r}
gpa1 <- tibble(
  name = c("Harry", "Hermione", "Ron"),
  year1 = c(3.7, 3.9, 3.1),
  year2 = c(3.8, 4, 3)
)
gpa1

gpa2 <- pivot_longer(
  data = gpa1, 
  cols = c(year1, year2), 
  names_to = "year", 
  values_to = "gpa")
gpa2
```

```{r}
gpa1 <- pivot_wider(
  data = gpa2, 
  names_from = year, 
  values_from = gpa)
gpa1
```
